expectations.evidence: 'Cut the first unreleased fixes now, one release per user-visible change.'

expectations.text: States that every Release is a feed event for the repository's stargazers and watchers, labelled [documented], so ten small releases reach them ten times where one reaches them once

expectations.text: States never to batch fixes to make a release look bigger
